title: COMPENDIUM of Achievements: the REC’s Contribution to Sounder Environment for Serbia and Montenegro
reference: COMPENDIUM of Achievements : the REC’s Contribution to Sounder Environment for Serbia and Montenegro (2001/4) / [ ilustrations Tatjana Kuburovi} ]. - Belgrade : The Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe, (REC) Country Office Serbia and Montenegro, 2004 (Belgrade : Publikum). - 167 str. : ilustr. ; 28 cm
publisher: The Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe, (REC) Country Office Serbia and Montenegro
description:
SOLUTIONS for People and the Environment

This publication provides a short overview of the REC's mission, objectives and main achievements in Serbia and Montenegro since receiving official status in 2001. We hope that the summary of the projects implemented by the REC in Serbia and Montenegro will bring new ideas to the readers of this publication on new project opportunities which can be jointly implemented and bring us solutions for people and the environment.
